caseNameFull: Bower, State Hospital Superintendent v. Vaughan
judges: Are, Black, Harlan, Noted, Set, Should

opinions.text:
Affirmed on appeal from D. C. Ariz. Motion of appellees for leave to proceed in forma pauperis granted.

Mr. Justice Black, Mr. Justice Harlan, and Mr. Justice White are of the opinion that probable jurisdiction should be noted and case set for oral argument.
